chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Any woman who donates her dower to her husband before he has intercourse with her, Allah will write for her the emancipation of a slave for every dinar.' It was said, 'O Messenger of Allah, what about gifting it after intercourse?' He said: 'That is from affection and companionship.'
ai.seo_question: What is the difference in reward between donating the dower before and after marital intercourse?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, this hadith distinguishes between the legal merit of returning the dower before consummation—rewarded proportionally to freeing slaves—and the relational virtue of gifting after, which reflects marital affection (mawaddah). This distinction highlights the Shia juristic view that while the pre-consummation return carries a specific, quantifiable spiritual debt, post-consummation generosity is valued for strengthening the emotional bond (al-ulfa) between spouses.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Whichever woman who donates upon her husband with her dower before he copulates with her, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Write for her (the reward of) the emancipation of a neck for each Dinar’. It was said, ‘O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! So how would it be with her gifting it after the copulation?’ He<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘But rather, that is from the cordiality and the kindness’.
en.sarwar: 15. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfaliy from al-Sakuniy who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Holy Prophet, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘If a woman gives her mahr (dower) as charity to her husband before going to bed with her, Allah writes for her for every dinar freeing of a slave.’ It was asked, ‘O Messenger of Allah, What is for gifting it after going to bed?’ He (the Messenger of Allah) said, ‘That is because of affection and kindness.’”
